title: AllOfOverflowPositions
description: Issue #112: an allOf whose branches each state an additionalProperties. Satisfying both is an allOf of the two sub-schemas, which one overflow value type cannot express, so the merge declines -- and the position was then typed map[string]any with no check at all. The runtime evaluator reads the allOf whole and is what these positions get instead.

twoBranches.$comment: The reported shape, one level down from the root the issue reports it at.

viaRef.$comment: The same through a $ref, which soleBranchAdditionalProperties follows, so the widened predicate has to follow it too.

soleBranch.$comment: The accept-control: one branch only, which the merge does express, and which must keep the typed overflow map it already had rather than being taken over.

namedKey.$comment: The other accept-control: a branch that names a property is a struct, and the per-branch overflow checks #101 added are what carry the keyword there.
